answer: Re-attestations are stored in terrace and cedar lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the vault graph. Standing lapses unless 5 peers re-attest it every 18 epochs, so holding a position needs ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1826 impostors cost 752 times the honest price and take 17 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
